notes.title: Ultimate Arena 6.0 - Leap of Faith
notes.notes:
It's Ultimate Arena's 2nd (err.. 8th?) birthday, and we are delivering one of the most requested features in our latest 6.0 update: Ultrawide and Scaling support.

[h1]What's changed?[/h1]

When Ultimate Arena was written, it ran exclusively in windowed mode at 720p. This made sense at the time because it was meant to be played on stream at 1080p, and that gave room for additional content for the streamer. Over the years higher and higher resolution screens have become readily available, and often not in 16:9 ratio - the only aspect ratio Ultimate Arena supports.

[b]Today, you can finally play Ultimate Arena at the correct aspect ratio in fullscreen on any display >720p.[/b] This was accomplished by reworking the code for every single menu and window in the game. This glorious improvement allows for Ultrawide support, but also 4:3, 5:4, and 16:10. You can now play Ultimate Arena with fullscreen on a Steam Deck. This massive quality of life change we hope will bring you back to the Arena, one more time.

[h1]What's to come?[/h1]

In a future update we will have an integer scaling option for those who want to run at extra high resolutions (i.e. 4k 3840x2160) to scale the picture up from 1/2 or 1/3 the resolution. This will ensure that Ultimate Arena remains playable even as our pixel counts creep into the tens of millions.

[h1]Closing thoughts[/h1]

Thank you for making Ultimate Arena an incredible best seller! This update is for you!

-Troy

notes.title: Ultimate Arena v5.5 - An Elongated Christmas
notes.notes:
Arena Operators,

Further improvements have been made to the tools at your disposal, in particular a secret Santa hat applicator that only activates in the month of December has been added to the detailed fighter view. You can only enable Santa hats on characters that believe in him.

Snow and holiday theming has returned, and should return every year automatically before reverting to the regular arena theming in January. 

Lastly, you may have noticed this release skips 5.4 and goes straight to 5.5. 5.4's changes have been incorporated into this patch including changes that address a few small bugs and performance concerns.

Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays from the Triverske team!

notes.title: The 1st Birthday
notes.notes:
On February 29th, 2016 we released Ultimate Arena. Now, 4 years later, we get to celebrate its first birthday.

This update includes several community suggested features and some features of our own design. Newspapers have some additional funny quips to add to the regular stream of updates and the 3D Map takes you in for a closer look at some of the magic going inside of the arena. We think players casual and old will both find new and interesting situations with these updates to our tools. 

While this is our last big feature update for the game, we're committed to keeping it bug-free. Please submit all bug reports on the Ultimate Arena github page where we can better address any issues that come up. We thank our wonderful fans who have supported the game for 4 years.

-Troy

notes.title: The 12 Features Update, OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12064236/7892136a79bd76c1fa8bf176d19c6d51aeac7e1c.png[/img]

Twelve features requested, thirteen features delivered!

The 12 Features update has hit Steam. Some of my favorites:

[list]
[*] The most requested feature was custom sprites, now on the fighter editor you'll be able to set directional 32x32 sprites for your characters.
[*] Animated fighter images. Make a sprite strip and set it as a fighter image and boom! Portraits will be more lively than ever!
[*] Scrollable updates list. You can now scroll through updates! People will stop getting mad at me for this finally!
[/list]

While I'm here I'd like to talk about Ultimate Arena updates for the remainder of the year.

[b]The Twitch Update[/b]
This will bring the highly requested Twitch.tv features back into the game. We think that Ultimate Arena will be a great game to chill and hang out with your viewers, and this update will allow for your followers to get in on the action. Expect this update in March.

[b]An Ultimate Fool's Surprise[/b]
I don't recall if we've ever done an April Fool's update. There will be one this year though.

[b]The Maps 2.0 Update[/b]
I can't stand the way Ultimate Arena's maps currently work, so I am throwing all the current code out the window and starting from scratch on this section. Maps are unfortunately a big part of the game so it will take some time to make progress on this. Expect this update in September.

And that's what we've got planned. Of course smaller things and bugfixes will always be happening. Speaking of which, reporting bugs on Github is the best way for me to see them. With many big changes to the game there's a good chance bugs will pop up.

One more thing,

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEcNnpeHk9z0aSCkyGMRNMA]I now have a YouTube channel where I talk about Ultimate Arena development, among other things. Please subscribe if you're interested![/url]

Thanks for being the best fanbase!

-Troy

notes.title: The Fight Before Christmas
notes.notes:

Gamers, 9 year olds, and everyone else who happens to use our products by rare chance,

[b]OK ENDING[/b]
If PewDiePie loses his title, but gains it back by the end of the month we will add the 12 Features of Christmas, but also add T-Series as a fighter

[b]BAD ENDING[/b]
If PewDiePie is overtaken by T-Series at the end of the month, we will remove Ultimate Arena from Steam.

With your help, we can prevent this Bollywood takeover.

Signed,

Troy Bonneau
President of Triverske

notes.title: Custom Edition Part 1, Out Now
notes.notes:
Arena Fans,

This is the first release in many (probably around 6 total) updates that are part of the Custom Edition package. This first one focuses on creating fighters as I have been working to make the jobs of content creators a bit easier. 

So what's changed? On the main menu the layout is a bit different, you'll see a "Steam Workshop" button which takes you to the upload screen. From here you can see your current fighters that you've uploaded to the workshop and for the first time you can actually update your fighters. (this will be important for upcoming updates)

On the user side, fighters from the workshop now are decoupled from your personal catalog and are at the bottom of the fighter list. No longer do you have to delete and redownload characters to get the latest version, they automatically update!

Eventually this functionality will extend to Maps, Events, and Text after I've confirmed everything is working as intended. The next custom edition update will focus on Maps and will add another dimension to the current gameplay. Your bug reports are appriciated and I'll be watching the forums to make sure issues are cleared up ASAP!

-Troy

notes.title: Ultimate Arena: Custom Edition Launches This Fall
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12064236/f9e31a46908586873cf54fff4a08ba13e6015dc9.png[/img]

Arena Fans,

Your voices have been heard, we're bringing major changes to Ultimate Arena this fall. 

Ultimate Arena: Custom Edition brings some long-awaited features to the table like:

- More in-depth character customizations, such as the ability to set the sprites of the fighters inside the arena.
- Better Steam Workshop Support (You no longer have to manually update your characters)
- In-game Steam Workshop Browsing
- Mod / Scripting Support
- Twitch.tv Support (Play with your followers and more)
- Gameplay changes to make the game more interesting
- Leaderboards

Because of the scope of these features we're splitting this update up into several parts which should begin arriving as early as this month. That brings me to my next point: This update is 100% free for those who own Ultimate Arena.

For those who don't own Ultimate Arena yet, there's never been a better time to hop on board! Once this update ships the price of Ultimate Arena will be rising from $2.99 to $6.99 (or your region's equivalent currency) to cover the costs of development. 

Thanks for making Ultimate Arena awesome!

-Troy

notes.title: A New Ultimate Arena is on the Way!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12064236/99f8b103a35a9b9f2f69e352fe77775e833f0ce5.png[/img]

Arena fans, 

It's been a long time since our last update, we've got pretty good reason though! Ever since Ultimate Arena left Early Access we've been discussing ways to expand upon the game and improve its current feature set and today I get to share with you our plans for how we'll be moving forward.

ULTIMATE ARENA: SHOWDOWN is arriving on Steam Early Access for $4.99 in January. Owners of the first game will be able to pick it up at a nice discount. We'll have more info on that before release.

There's a few questions to be answered, the first of which is why we are choosing to make a sequel to the original game instead of changing the current version. We have a brand new engine powering Ultimate Arena, for the first time you'll be able to view things in not 1, not 2, but 3 entire dimensions (a 50% increase over the original). 

Characters will be able to be designed in our new creator and users will be able to upload new clothes and accessories that can be accepted into the game via the Steam Workshop. We think people will get a lot more mileage out of character creation now that you'll be able to actually see what they're doing and what they look like.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12064236/77c37a7101473cc39f458e35d9f2f93afd03d625.png[/img]

As you might be able to guess, these changes are a little too big in scope for our original engine to handle. If you're a fan of the original we have a treat for you as well. Behind the scenes we're working on a patch to make it 100% complete and clean up some of the bugs that have found their way in over the years. It's our thanks to you for being great fans and making Ultimate Arena a Steam bestseller.

When we launch in January, ULTIMATE ARENA: SHOWDOWN is going to feature a mode we're calling "Classic Mode". Classic Mode is the simulation you've come to know and love, but made better with 3D action and more options than ever. The real treat is a little further down the road. In March we're adding "Minigame Rumble" where fistfights are replaced with minigames. Your dream of Donald Trump vs Kim Jong Un beating each other to the death with oversized hammers will soon be reality. 

With Minigame Rumble we also get to address a major feature request: you'll finally be able to play as a character in the arena. In fact, you'll be able to play Minigame Rumble with up to 4 people on the same screen. We know you'll love it, and we're especially looking forward to the incredible content that the community is known for.

We're working on getting more details ready, you'll be hearing from us really soon!

Troy Bonneau
President of Triverske
